values.name: Aberration
values.description: A creature whose form and thought are alien to the natural world — unsettling to look at and often incomprehensible in motive.

values.name: Beast
values.description: A natural, non-magical animal, though often larger, fiercer, or stranger than its mundane cousins.

values.name: Celestial
values.description: A creature native to the upper planes, acting (or claiming to act) with a purpose sanctioned by a greater power.

values.name: Construct
values.description: An animated object or artificial body, built or shaped rather than born, following its programming or binding rather than instinct.

values.name: Dragon
values.description: A reptilian creature of ancient, often magical lineage — proud, territorial, and rarely anyone's servant by choice.

values.name: Elemental
values.description: A creature made manifest from one of the fundamental planes of existence, acting on straightforward, often single-minded impulses.

values.name: Fey
values.description: A creature tied to the vitality of nature and bound (whether it admits it or not) by old, strange rules of bargain and trickery.

values.name: Fiend
values.description: A creature of wickedness native to (or long corrupted by) the lower planes, acting with malice and purpose.

values.name: Giant
values.description: A humanoid-shaped creature of great size and strength, from a society with its own old, rigid sense of order.

values.name: Humanoid
values.description: A creature of the common mortal races, organized into societies, professions, and factions much like the player characters.

values.name: Monstrosity
values.description: A frightening creature not entirely natural, often the product of magic gone wrong or a bloodline warped by it.

values.name: Ooze
values.description: A creature with a gelatinous, near-formless body — mindless in most cases, but relentless in what little it does pursue.

values.name: Plant
values.description: A creature of vegetable rather than animal nature, ranging from barely mobile to aggressively territorial.

values.name: Undead
values.description: Animated remains or restless spirits, driven by hunger, compulsion, or unfinished business rather than a living creature's needs.
